name: HR Dashboard - live KPIs + daily Slack digest

parameters.content:
## HR Dashboard (live)
**Setup (2 min)**
1. Open **Config** and paste your Google Sheet ID; set the 4 tab names.
2. Attach your Google Sheets credential on the 4 *Read* nodes.
3. Slack node: pick your channel + credential (or delete the Slack branch).
4. Activate, then open the **Production URL** of the Webhook node.

Column headers differ? Edit the `COLS` block at the top of the **Aggregate & Render** node.
No data is written anywhere - this workflow only reads.
